_comment: Phase R main campaign on wrx (BENCH_PLAN sections 1 and 9, draft 6.8 matrix). Repeats stand for hosts (wrx-r1..r3). Arms by readable label: no-disk (C0), write-through (T), write-hot (T2), lmcache (LM), continuum (CT), layby (K), layby-ewma (K_ewma), layby-avg (K_km). best = the lowest stage-3 tuning p95 among the tuned baselines per model and disk (cells/wrx/tune/tuned.json, sha b9f44784), restricted to the arms the cell runs: Qwen slow write-hot 9.93 s; Gemma slow write-hot 42.38 s; Qwen fast write-through 8.53 s; Gemma fast write-hot 32.55 s is not in the draft 6.8 fast matrix, so write-through 32.69 s. H5 here is TPOT only (draft 6.8 dropped the throughput sweep); H6 needs the simulator's committed predictions and is run separately.
